sentences.text: This longitudinal study examined a nationally representative sample of community-dwelling adults aged 60 and older across two waves.

Researchers classified dementia using an algorithm based on cognitive tests, functional status, and informant reports, identifying cases as undiagnosed when no prior physician diagnosis of Alzheimer disease existed.
The authors note that substantial regional inequalities remain and that further targeted policies are needed to close diagnostic gaps in isolated areas.
